## Wireless@SGX Explorer · n8n portfolio
Set your Explorer API URL in Configure API and examples. If protected, select Header Auth credentials on Shared Explorer API (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN). Never put secrets in this export.

Five read-only operations demonstrate the shared catalogue. This manual-only template has no public webhook. Distances are straight-line and coverage/availability are unverified. See docs/portfolio.md for the production MCP/tool pattern.
